title: Search for the missing team brought in Sturgis deputies and a state trooper
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field / Sturgis, South Dakota

I didn't know this till 2021 was that uh two deputy sheriffs had been dispatched from Sturgis, South Dakota by request of the wings of wing security control

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 1977 search for the missing team, in which wing security brought in two Sturgis deputies and a state trooper, a fact Mario learned in 2021.

as_told.title: Sturgis sheriff's deputies and a state trooper sent to find them

plain: Mario Woods, a former Air Force guard at nuclear missile sites, says that when his team went missing in the missile field near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977, on a night he describes as an abduction, the base's security control asked for outside help, and two deputies from Sturgis and a state trooper were sent to search for them. Woods says he did not learn this until 2021, and in one telling he credits a Meade County sheriff's dispatch log. If true, the search shows that the team's disappearance was real enough for the base to call in local police.
